shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*' -iname '*dialog*' -o -path '*docs*' -iname '*modal*' | head -20; printf '\\n--- dialog docs ---\\n'; if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Dialog/README.md ]; then sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Dialog/README.md; elif [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs/... ]; then :; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -l \"declare const Dialog|interface DialogProps|type DialogProps|interface ModalProps|declare const Modal\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; printf '\\n--- docs dirs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type d \\( -name docs -o -name README.md \\) | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; rg -n \"DialogProps|ButtonProps|size|view|onUpdate|open\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -100; printf '\\n--- button types ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface ButtonProps|view:|size:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"view|size|onClick\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -60; printf '\\n--- dialog footer/header props ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts"
